x-constraints: min_font_size <= font_size after resolving omitted defaults

anchor.description: Normalized x and baseline y in canvas coordinates

region.description: Normalized allowed rectangle: left, top, right, bottom

color.x-format: opaque_rgb; opacity is a separate field

enabled.description: Explicitly disabled layers produce no asset

required.description: Missing content fails when enabled and required

sha256.description: Optional required primary font or image byte identity

outline_color.x-format: opaque_rgb; opacity is a separate field

shadow_color.x-format: opaque_rgb; opacity is a separate field

suffix_scale.description: True verse-end number size relative to fitted body size

x-constraints: min_font_size <= font_size after resolving omitted defaults

line_spacing.description: Extra distance after the largest line ink height; legacy baseline rhythm

horizontal_scale.description: Scale the complete shaped line horizontally

decoration_scale.description: Quotation font size relative to fitted body size

word_spacing.description: Additional word gap in em of the final fitted font; zero preserves legacy spacing
x-constraints: requires native Wand-RAQM for nonzero spacing

line_height.description: Baseline step in fitted em; zero uses legacy line_spacing

tracking.description: Additional Latin grapheme gap in fitted em; optional cross-grapheme ligatures are disabled
x-constraints: nonzero tracking supports LTR Latin graphemes only
